full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white comic illustration shows a solitary man seated on a low brick ledge in a small paved courtyard. The scene sits inside a thin rectangular panel border with a white margin around it. At left, a brick wall rises diagonally into the upper corner, each block defined by fine ink texture. A hard-edged wedge of sunlight cuts across that wall, leaving the upper center and right in flat black shadow. The man sits just left of center, his shoulders rounded and head lowered. He wears a loose jacket, light trousers, and pale shoes, with one forearm resting across his knees and the other hand near his face. A soft bag or coat lies on the ledge to his left. His face is mostly hidden by the bowed posture and the surrounding shadow. Behind him, a low pale wall extends toward the right, where two dark human-shaped shadows fall across it and the ground. A small area of foliage rises beyond the wall at the upper-right edge. The foreground paving stones are bright white, their seams forming an irregular grid that recedes toward the seated figure; a few tiny debris marks interrupt the open floor. The viewpoint is slightly elevated but close enough to show folds in clothing and cracks in brick. Strong direct sunlight creates crisp black shapes beneath the ledge and behind the man, while the lit pavement remains almost unshaded. The overall composition isolates the figure between a detailed wall and a vast black corner, using clean panel framing and stark contrast for a reflective mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白漫画插画呈现一名独自坐在低矮砖台上的男子，地点是小小的铺砖庭院。场景置于细长方形画格边框内，四周留白。左侧砖墙斜向上角升起，每块砖由细墨线肌理界定。一道硬边阳光楔形切过墙面，使上方中央与右侧落成平坦黑影。男子坐在中央偏左，肩膀弓起，低下头。他穿宽松外套、浅色长裤和浅色鞋，一只前臂搁在膝上，另一只手靠近脸。软布包或外套放在他左侧砖台上。低头姿态和周围阴影使脸大多看不见。身后低矮浅色墙向右延伸，两道深色人形阴影落在墙和地面上。右上缘有一小片枝叶从墙后升起。前景铺石明亮近白，接缝形成向坐着人物后退的不规则格网；零星细碎杂物痕迹打断开放地面。视点略高，但仍足够近，可看出衣褶和砖缝。强烈直射日光在砖台下和人物背后留下清楚的黑形，受光路面则几乎没有明暗。整体构图把人物孤立在细节丰富的墙和大片黑色角落之间，以清楚画格和强反差形成沉思气氛。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white comics drawing uses hard-edged shadow, inked architectural texture, and controlled white page margins. Dense crosshatching describes rough material, while large solid black areas compress space and direct attention toward a small lit subject. A diagonal light wedge and receding rectangular seams give the frame strong geometry. Fine contour work is reserved for clothing folds and face-adjacent details; open surfaces remain mostly white. Daylight is severe and directional, making silhouettes and cast shapes clearer than tonal gradients. A single bordered panel holds the scene apart from surrounding blank paper. The overall effect is contemplative, graphic, and structurally precise.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白漫画绘画使用硬边阴影、墨线建筑肌理和受控的白纸边距。密集交叉排线描绘粗糙材质，大片实心黑色压缩空间，并把注意力引向受光的小形体。斜向亮光楔形与后退的长方接缝赋予画格强烈几何感。细轮廓只用于衣褶和靠近脸部的细节；开放表面大多保持白色。日光强硬且有方向性，使剪影和投影比明度渐变更清楚。单个带边框画格把场景同周围空白纸面分开。整体效果沉思、图形感强且结构精确。
theme_en: A solitary seated man in a sunlit brick courtyard comic panel
theme_zh: 一名独坐男子位于阳光照亮的砖砌庭院漫画画格中
name: Scott McCloud
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
